alpha_independence_note: alpha affects ONLY the final route selection. The generation-zero progress reference, the in-loop stagnation comparison, the convergence generation and the evaluated Pareto front all use the frozen default search policy above, so the GA trajectory is identical across the four alphas. Only the returned route, its guardrail status and its fallback flag may vary.
supersedes_note: The original results/thermal_tradeoff_sensitivity/ run mixed an alpha-sensitive generation-zero selection with an alpha-independent in-loop stagnation selection, which made the search trajectory unintentionally alpha-dependent. It is preserved unchanged and is superseded by this V2 run.

c2_policy.u_star_definition: max(first-front maximum utility, seed-matched non-thermal reference utility)

non_thermal_baseline_note: The non-thermal baseline is deterministic and alpha-independent, so it is computed once per (instance, seed) and replicated across the four alphas.
seed_interpretation: The ten seeds are repeated stochastic optimisation runs for stability and paired comparison, not ten independent real-world disruptions.
original_result_preserved: results/weather_ablation/ is untouched; the frozen 90-pair null result remains the confirmatory result. results/thermal_tradeoff_sensitivity/ is also left unchanged and is superseded by this V2 run.
